messages:
nora-swe: Hi team — planning to work from Santiago, Chile for ~45 days (Sep 3 -> Oct 17). Quick Qs: 1) Will my WFH stipend be prorated for 45 days? 2) Ill bring my MacBook and a small desktop keyboard (personal). Any customs/import docs I should worry about? 3) Do I need to declare a temporary homebase? 4) Any payroll/tax flags for ~6 weeks?

jamie-peopleops: Short answers: stipend = prorated by calendar days for temporary moves under 90 days; submit Temporary Location form to start checks; record device serials on the form. We'll run payroll/legal checks once form is in.

lucia-legal: For Chile: tax residency kicks in at 183 days, so 45 days is fine for residency. However, local contracting or selling services locally can create employer/local presence issues. Do not sign local contracts. If you meet customers in person, flag it.

pablo-payroll: Payroll notes: stipends processed through payroll, taxed per your home payroll rules. Confirm whether you want stipend paid in USD or CLP. For 45d we typically do not gross-up. If youre paid to a local account we may need a W-8/W-9 equivalent — we'll advise after the form.

shipops: Shipping note: Chile has strict import checks on electronics. If company vendor handles shipping we provide ATA carnet/temporary export docs where possible. But many couriers refuse non-commercial personal items. If you personally carry the keyboard, note customs can ask for proof it's personal. For company devices: use ShipOps (shipops@redwood.com).

nora-swe: Thanks — I'm planning to carry the keyboard in checked luggage and bring company MacBook as carry-on. I'll fill the Temporary Location form now. Also got an unexpected ping: a local startup asked me to do a paid 1-off consulting review while there. Can I accept?

lucia-legal: Do NOT accept any paid consulting or contracting while on Redwood payroll. That creates immediate tax/employment risk. If theyre just coffee/intro chats, fine; paid work = no.

jamie-peopleops: Also heads-up: if your stay extends beyond 90 days, ping payroll/legal immediately. Ticket created when you submit the form to track approvals and shipping.

ticket-bot: HR case created: HR-9920 "Temporary remote: Santiago 2026-09-03 to 2026-10-17 (Nora)". Assigned to people-ops/jamie.

nora-swe: Filling the form now and attaching passport + device serial. Preference: stipend in USD. Will CC my manager. Thanks all :airplane:
